rv.q: Foy and Smith manage the switches of mood and tone with a virtuosity that verges on ostentatious, and there are very few off-moments in pace.
Smith and Foy are always watchable, and ‘Lungs’ is funny throughout.
This is an absorbing evening not because of any large environmental claims but because of the needling but generous dialogue that takes you into the heart of a couple.
It is hard to imagine a finer outing for it than Matthew Warchus’ gleaming, ideally paced Old Vic production starring Claire Foy and Matt Smith.
What could have been a static, cerebral evening turns out to be an exhilarating roller-coaster of a ride, as Foy and Smith demonstrate their undeniable chemistry and considerable acting skills.
